The safety level of high goods is equal to the price. However, flexibility cannot be equal to other vehicles for which trains only run on fixed rail routes.

The cargo can be transported from where the production is to where the consumption or goods are from the depot to the depot. However, the weakness of this type is quite high, the riskability is also high due to traffic accidents.
Vận tải hàng hóa bằng đường bộ có vai tr.zh: 公路运输在经济增长中起重要作用。 这种运输方法的显著优势是灵活性,机动性,满足不同客户需求的实用性. 货物可以从生产地运往消费地或货物从仓库运往仓库。 然而,这种类型的弱点相当高,由于交通事故,风险也很高.
